changes: Shared diffuse landscapes and glass surfaces across all six themes, rounded ON/OFF controls, a compact administration directory and smoother responsive navigation.

Public roadmap and GitHub feature requests for future memberships, Aurora, guided media-server setup and member invitations.

Structured user profiles, full-width user/group permission sections and immediate language selection from a compact list with flags.
